# AMEVA-Core (v1.0.0)
> High-Performance Edge & Browser Native Open-Source Systems Library

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/uno-km
- Installation: `pip install ameva-core
# or: npm install @ameva/core`
- Architecture: Eliminates server roundtrips by compiling low-level kernels directly to WebGPU/Bionic ARM64 with zero-leak buffer pooling and closed-form mathematical precision.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
import ameva_core as ac
engine = ac.Engine()
print(engine.compute([1.0, 2.0]))
```

## Key Constraints
- Pure non-blocking architecture, zero memory leaks.
- Strictly adhere to closed-form precision and WebGPU/Bionic ARM64 native targets.
